name: home-stairwell
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: original full-screen pixel-art interlude for Next, Please!, native viewport 570 x 320.
Style: match the approved subdued analog clinic and domestic artwork: crisp low-resolution square pixel clusters, worn ordinary 1983 interiors, dark charcoal-olive shadows, warm amber practical light, aged wood, dull cream, restrained rust accents. Original polished game illustration, not a photo, no smooth painted gradients or blur.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, ideally 1710 x 960. The LEFT 62 PERCENT (native x0-353) must remain very dark, low-contrast, nearly empty shadow with only subtle wall texture, for separately rendered localized text and red budget numbers. Main objects and all bright light on the RIGHT 38 PERCENT. Bottom-left stays quiet for a button. Natural continuous scene across the whole frame, no panels or artificial overlay.
Constraints: no visible people, no modern electronics, no readable writing, letters, digits, currency symbols, logos, flags, identifiable city or country, watermark, UI, borders. Papers may show only faint indecipherable strokes. Do not draw any text. No snow or conspicuous seasonal vegetation. Opaque background.
Scene: Returning home through an old apartment stairwell. On the right: a short flight of worn terrazzo stairs and wooden handrail leading to a partly open apartment door, warm domestic light spilling over the upper step. Cream ceramic wall fitting, rubbed olive paint, a modest doormat. Left is a deep shadowed stairwell wall. A quiet pause after a long shift.
